Round safety

Report your opponent

Debatable reviews safety reports within 24 hours. Leave the round whenever you feel unsafe.

Their transcript gets an automatic screen for AI-written text, and a human reviews the report with that evidence attached. The screen is advisory: it never decides this round or applies a penalty on its own, and the judge never sees it.
